$note: The PowerPoint viewer, approved 2026-10-06 (DL-125). kind=board: a part of the window drawn on the Design canvas, exported as static HTML.

screens.shows: Slides scroll at the pane's width, numbered; the bar under the tabs: previous, next, Slide n of N (the slide filling most of the pane), Select Shape, Open With.
NOT CHOSEN (DL-125 picked A): one slide centred with a strip of numbered thumbnails.
Select Shape pressed; a dashed outline and the shape's name over the shape under the pointer; the picker bar: Click a shape on a slide to select it. Esc to stop. Cancel.
A solid 1.5 outline and the name over the picked shape; the bar: <name> on slide n · “text”, In <groups>, Send to Claude (default), Send To, Pick Another, Cancel.

Send to Claude pastes the shape into Claude's prompt without Return (Claude Code shows [Pasted text]); the pasted text: file, slide n of N, name and id, type, groups, text, box on the slide, the duo2 command for the whole slide, a screenshot.
A deck the renderer can't open (password, damaged): the notice says why and that Claude can't read its slides either, Open With, Show in Finder, over Quick Look.
